basic_info.description: The entire property will be delivered vacant. Coldwell Banker Commercial is pleased to present 1385-1387 Vallejo Street, a two-unit property in the heart of San Francisco's Russian Hill neighborhood. The lower unit is a two-bedroom, one-bathroom flat with a formal living room, formal dining room, and in-unit laundry machines. The upper unit is a two-level penthouse unit with four bedrooms and two bathrooms & rear deck attached. The units offer separate entrances and spacious layouts with generous square footage.​ The property includes a beautiful backyard in the rear of the parcel.    This property is located in a prime location just one block to Polk Street, where you'll find Philz Coffee, Cole Hardware, Blue Barn, Greens Sports Bar, Walgreens, Crunch Fitness, and a variety of other shops and restaurants.​ Don't miss the opportunity to own this magnificent, one-of-a-kind property in an excellent location on Russian Hill!
